33418.a:
**Muammo:** Linux'da PID 1 maxsus:
- Signalga default handler yo'q — app SIGTERM'ni o'zi ushlamasa, `docker stop` 10s kutib SIGKILL beradi.
- Orphan process'lar PID 1'ga o'tadi; u `wait()` qilmasa `<defunct>` zombie'lar to'planib, PID limitni yeydi.

Kim zarar ko'radi: shell script entrypoint, child process ochadigan app (Node, Python, cron, headless Chrome).

```sh
docker run --init myimage            # Docker o'zi tini qo'shadi
```
```dockerfile
RUN apk add --no-cache tini
ENTRYPOINT ["/sbin/tini", "--", "/app"]
```
Kubernetes'da: `shareProcessNamespace: true` bo'lsa pause container PID 1 bo'ladi va zombie'larni yig'adi.

Go binary child ochmasa va SIGTERM'ni ushlasa — tini shart emas.

33419.a:
```sh
# docker.sock mount qilingan container ichidan:
docker run -v /:/host -it alpine chroot /host     # host'da root shell
```

| Narsa | Nima beradi | Alternativa |
|---|---|---|
| `docker.sock` mount | Host root | CI build uchun Kaniko/BuildKit rootless, monitoring uchun read-only API proxy |
| `--privileged` | Barcha capability, `/dev`, seccomp/AppArmor o'chiq | Kerakli bitta capability: `--cap-add NET_ADMIN` |
| `hostPath: /` (K8s) | Host fayl tizimi | PVC, configMap |

Kubernetes'da Pod Security Admission `restricted` / `baseline` bularni bloklaydi.

33420.a:
| Vosita | Xususiyat |
|---|---|
| DinD (`docker:dind`) | Oddiy, lekin `privileged: true` — xavfli |
| Kaniko | Daemon yo'q, privileged yo'q, registry'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri push, remote cache |
| BuildKit rootless | Tez, cache mount, multi-arch |
| Buildah / Podman | Daemon'siz, rootless |

```yaml
# GitLab CI
build:
  image: { name: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:debug, entrypoint: [""] }
  script:
    - /kaniko/executor --context $CI_PROJECT_DIR
        --destination $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA --cache=true
```
Eslatma: Kaniko upstream'da arxivlangan — yangi loyihalar uchun BuildKit (rootless) yoki Buildah ko'proq tavsiya etiladi.

33421.a:
```
 container layer (RW, upperdir)   <- yozish shu yerga
 ---------------------------------
 layer 3: COPY app                (RO)
 layer 2: RUN apk add             (RO)  lowerdir
 layer 1: alpine base             (RO)
```

Oqibatlari:
- 10 ta container bitta image'dan — layer'lar diskda bir marta.
- Katta faylni container ichida o'zgartirish sekin (butun fayl nusxalanadi) — DB data'si volume'da bo'lishi shart.
- `RUN rm big.tar` keyingi layer'da — image kichraymaydi; bitta `RUN` ichida yuklab, ishlatib, o'chirish kerak.
- `docker diff <id>` — container layer'ida nima o'zgargan.

33422.a:
```sh
kubectl get pod api-0 -o jsonpath='{.metadata.finalizers}'
kubectl describe pod api-0          # Events: volume detach?
kubectl get node <node>             # NotReady?
```

| Sabab | Yechim |
|---|---|
| Node NotReady / o'chgan | Node'ni tiklash yoki `kubectl delete node` |
| Finalizer (controller ishlamayapti) | Controller'ni tuzatish; oxirgi chora — finalizer'ni patch bilan olib tashlash |
| Volume detach osildi (EBS) | CSI driver log'lari, cloud console |
| App SIGTERM'ni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi | Grace period tugagach o'zi o'ladi |

```sh
kubectl delete pod api-0 --grace-period=0 --force
```
**Ogohlantirish:** force delete faqat API'dan o'chiradi; container node'da hali ishlashi mumkin. StatefulSet'da bir xil identitetli ikkinchi pod paydo bo'lib, bir diskka ikkalasi yozishi mumkin.

33423.a:
| Exit | Signal | Odatiy sabab |
|---|---|---|
| 143 | SIGTERM (15) | Rolling update, drain, liveness probe fail, scale down |
| 137 | SIGKILL (9) | OOMKilled yoki SIGTERM'dan keyin grace period tugadi |
| 0 | — | Process o'zi tugadi (Job uchun normal, Deployment'da restart) |

```sh
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated}'
# reason: OOMKilled / Error / Completed
```

137 bo'lsa va `reason` OOMKilled emas — app SIGTERM'ga javob bermayapti (graceful shutdown yo'q yoki PID 1 muammosi). 143 tez-tez bo'lsa — liveness probe'ni tekshiring.

33424.a:
```
# pod /etc/resolv.conf
search prod.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local
options ndots:5
```

`api.stripe.com` (2 nuqta) uchun ketma-ket:
```
api.stripe.com.prod.svc.cluster.local  NXDOMAIN
api.stripe.com.svc.cluster.local       NXDOMAIN
api.stripe.com.cluster.local           NXDOMAIN
api.stripe.com                         OK
```
Har biri A va AAAA — 8 ta so'rov.

**Yechim:**
- FQDN oxiriga nuqta: `api.stripe.com.`
- Pod spec: `dnsConfig: { options: [{ name: ndots, value: "2" }] }`
- NodeLocal DNSCache — node darajasida kesh, conntrack muammolarini ham kamaytiradi.
- CoreDNS replika/autoscale va `cache` plugin.

33425.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata: { name: letsencrypt }
spec:
  acme:
    server: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
    email: ops@example.com
    privateKeySecretRef: { name: le-account }
    solvers:
      - http01: { ingress: { ingressClassName: nginx } }
---
# Ingress
metadata:
  annotations: { cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt }
spec:
  tls:
    - hosts: [api.example.com]
      secretName: api-tls
```

Debug: `kubectl get certificate,certificaterequest,order,challenge` — qaysi bosqichda osilganini ko'rsatadi. Wildcard uchun DNS-01 solver kerak. Rate limit'dan qochish uchun avval staging server.

33426.a:
```yaml
volumeMounts:
  - name: cfg
    mountPath: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    subPath: nginx.conf        # yangilanmaydi!
```

| Usul | ConfigMap yangilansa |
|---|---|
| volume (butun papka) | Fayl ~kubelet sync davrida yangilanadi |
| `subPath` | Yangilanmaydi |
| env (`envFrom`) | Yangilanmaydi |

**Yechim:** butun papkani alohida joyga mount qilib, app'ni u yerdan o'qitish; yoki rollout (checksum annotation, Reloader). Fayl yangilansa ham app uni qayta o'qishi kerak (inotify yoki SIGHUP).

33427.a:
```yaml
rules:
  - host: example.com
    http:
      paths:
        - path: /api
          pathType: Prefix          # /api, /api/, /api/users
          backend: { service: { name: api, port: { number: 80 } } }
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix          # qolgan hammasi
          backend: { service: { name: web, port: { number: 80 } } }
```

Gotcha: `Prefix /api` `/apiv2`ni ushlamaydi. Path'ni backend'ga yuborishdan oldin kesish (rewrite) — controller annotation'i (`nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target`), standart emas. Ingress-NGINX loyihasi qo'llab-quvvatlashdan chiqmoqda — yangi loyihalarda Gateway API (`HTTPRoute`) ko'rib chiqiladi.

33428.a:
```sh
kubectl apply --server-side --field-manager=ci -f deploy.yaml
kubectl get deploy api -o yaml --show-managed-fields
```

Misol: HPA `replicas`ni boshqaradi, CI manifestda ham `replicas: 3` bor → har deploy'da 3 ga qaytadi. Yechim: manifestdan `replicas`ni olib tashlash (yoki ArgoCD'da `ignoreDifferences`) — field egasi bitta bo'lsin.

SSA afzalliklari: katta CRD'larda annotation 256KB limitiga tushmaydi, conflict aniq ko'rinadi.

33429.a:
```sh
kubectl get events -n prod --sort-by=.lastTimestamp
kubectl get events -A --field-selector type=Warning
kubectl events --for pod/api-xyz -w     # yangi kubectl
```

| Reason | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| FailedScheduling | Joy/affinity/taint |
| FailedMount / FailedAttachVolume | PVC, CSI, secret yo'q |
| Unhealthy | Probe fail |
| BackOff | CrashLoop yoki image pull |
| Evicted | Node bosimi |

Events etcd'da TTL bilan (default 1h) — tarix uchun kubernetes-event-exporter → Loki/Elastic.

33430.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: migrate-{{ .Release.Revision }}
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": pre-upgrade,pre-install
    "helm.sh/hook-weight": "0"
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": before-hook-creation,hook-succeeded
spec:
  backoffLimit: 1
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 600
```

**Xavflar va qoidalar:**
- `helm rollback` sxemani qaytarmaydi — migratsiya backward-compatible bo'lsin (expand/contract).
- `activeDeadlineSeconds` bo'lmasa osilgan Job release'ni `pending-upgrade`da qoldiradi.
- ArgoCD Helm hook'larni o'z sync hook'lariga map qiladi (`PreSync`), `helm install` emas.
- Hook resurslari release tarkibida kuzatilmaydi — o'chirish policy'si kerak.

33431.a:
```yaml
# Chart.yaml
dependencies:
  - name: redis
    version: 20.x.x
    repository: oci://registry-1.docker.io/bitnamicharts
    condition: redis.enabled
```
`helm dependency update` → `Chart.lock` va `charts/*.tgz`. Lock commit qilinadi — reproducible build.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["image"],
  "properties": {
    "replicas": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 },
    "image": { "type": "object", "required": ["tag"],
               "properties": { "tag": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{7,}$|^v?[0-9]" } } }
  }
}
```
`replicas: "3"` (string) yoki tag yo'q — deploy'dan oldin xato. Subchart values: `redis.auth.enabled` kabi chart nomi ostida.
